Poor quality of services, staff not proactive and VIOLATION OF PRIVACY
Jul 2020
We had business dinner there and I have to say that the quality of the food was mediocre.Also the staff isn't really responsive nor pro-active at all so you have to always chase after a waiter/staff if you want them to serve you any drink or food. Plus they did forgot many times to bring me my drinks so I have to remind x3 different people like x2 times each staff. 

One last thing is that we had pictures taken during this dinner that was ONLY for privacy use BUT the restaurant decided to used my picture with my FACE on it WITHOUT ANY PERMISSION OR ASKING. They had run a whole marketing campaign across Facebook, instagram and other social media WITHOUT ASKING MY AUTHORIZATION UPFRONT and making money out of it. 
This is such a violation of privacy, and when I asked them to take down my pictures and to pay damages and interest: to pay the fact that they are using MY FACE FOR FREE to represent their company and they make money to promote it with my picture they just asked you what is your phone number to apologize sincerely... 

This is just a SHAME of they treat their client and so unrespectful in every possible way. 

My only recommendation for this place: please do not go there as this doesn't worth the money that you will spend there as poor service, poor food and drinks, worst quality of customer services ever that you will experience and a risk of violation of privacy by using your pictures without asking any permission upfront.

maese5400
Baden, Switzerland38 contributions

Ok.
Jul 2019
We all know that many ratings are a bit too generous, thats why I try to be critical at this restaurant.

For sure, it‘s a very nice restaurant, beautiful and very stylish furniture, the staff was friendly and the prices are fair.
But here my criticism:
There were about 8 other guest in this huge hall of restaurant, so with more staff then guests, there was not really a cozy atmosphere - maybe its different during lunch at business times...
The two beers we ordered (sapporo & bohemian lager) were both not available. A bit sad, because sapporo was the only japanese beer on the menu... ok.
The menu is nice but different (don’t expect katsudon, ume-shu or sushi yet - but I think they are still extending it)
The food we ordered was nice, but not outstanding.
The worst small detail was in the end on the bill - they charged us the wet tissue, 2x 10.000 dong - i think this is ridiculous in a restaurant.
Sorry but that‘s why you get only 3 stars - I hope you take it more as a chance to work on it.
